evidence.claim: Mölnlycke Health Care AB reports the introduction of Mepilex Up in 2024, an advanced foam dressing built with a patented dimpled foam structure that enhances capillary action to manage fluids and spread exudates evenly in all directions within chronic wounds.

An independent clinical case study series published in the Journal of Wound Care evaluating a new portable single-use canister-based negative pressure wound therapy system confirmed that four adult patients treated at home achieved therapeutic vacuum levels safely, with patients reporting that the system's slower, progressive pressure induction was highly comfortable compared to prior high-pressure traditional units.
